name: Voxtral-Mini-3B-2507
notes: TWO-PART MODEL, audio-in / text-out (Mistral's ASR model -- it transcribes, it does not speak). This is encoder-decoder in the precompute sense: a Whisper-style AUDIO ENCODER feeds a causal text LLM through a projector, and all decoding happens in the LLM. (1) AUDIO ENCODER (the compute-heavy part): model_type voxtral_encoder, 32 layers, hidden_size 1280, 20 heads AND 20 KV heads (MHA), head_dim 64, intermediate 5120, gelu, num_mel_bins 128, max_source_positions 1500, vocab_size 51866 (the Whisper vocabulary, i.e. the encoder's output space is Whisper-shaped). Preprocessor: WhisperFeatureExtractor, chunk_length 30s, n_samples 480,000, nb_max_frames 3000, sampling_rate 16000, n_fft 400, hop 160, feature_size 128. So exactly the Whisper input pipeline and encoder geometry -- which is what lets Mistral reuse Whisper's audio stack wholesale. AUDIO TOKENS: 1,500 encoder positions per 30s chunk. NO KV CACHE FOR THE ENCODER: single bidirectional pass, nothing cached. Unlike Whisper there is also no separate cross-attention KV -- the projector feeds the LLM as a prefix of tokens, so the 1,500 audio positions enter the LLM's own KV cache like any other prefix. That is a simpler memory story than encoder-decoder cross-attention. (2) LLM: llama dense decoder, 30 layers, hidden 3072, 32 heads / 8 KV heads, head_dim 128, intermediate 8192, vocab 131,072, max_position 131,072, rope_theta 1e8, rope_scaling null, attention_bias false, tie via pretraining_tp 1. projector_hidden_act gelu. ARCHITECTURE = dense. PROJECTOR: a 2-layer MLP (projector_hidden_act) mapping the 1280-dim audio encoder to the 3072-dim LLM. AUDIO DYNAMICS: audio_token_id 24. KV CACHE: 30 * 8 * 128 * 2 * 2 = 122,880 B/token (120 KiB) -- LLM self-attention only; the audio encoder contributes nothing per token. Note that the 1,500 audio tokens DO occupy this cache, so a single 30s transcription request pins 1,500 * 122,880 = 184 MiB of LLM KV before the first output token, growing with each generated token. That prefix cost is inherent to the prefix-projection design and is worth budgeting against Whisper's fixed 234 MiB cross-attention. STREAMING vs OFFLINE: OFFLINE, same as Whisper -- bidirectional 1,500-position encoder over a fixed 30s chunk (preprocessor chunk_length 30). Not streamable without re-architecting the encoder. NAME vs REALITY: the name says 3B but the HF API safetensors total is 4,676,271,104 (4.676B). The gap is the audio encoder plus a large untied embedding: the text body alone is ~3.4B (30 layers x (4*3072^2 attention + 3*3072*8192 MLP) = 30 x 113M) and the two 131,072 x 3072 embedding matrices add 805M. The '3B' marketing figure appears to count the text backbone only. Recorded as 4.676 from tensors, which is authoritative; the naming discrepancy is flagged rather than resolved. flops_per_token_active is NULL rather than 2*params for the same reason as Whisper: the 1,500-position encoder precompute dominates and is not a per-generated-token cost.
